info.title: ytx extracts YouTube video metadata and captions as JSON.
info.description: Extract YouTube metadata and transcripts as JSON, Markdown, plain text, SRT or WebVTT, with a stable output contract for scripts and agents.

options.name: --url
options.description: Specify the YouTube URL or video ID explicitly.

options.name: --language
options.description:
Prefer captions matching a language name or code
(default: English). Falls back to English, then
any track, with a warning on stderr.

options.name: --metadata-only
options.description: Skip caption retrieval and return metadata only.

options.name: --format
options.description:
json (default), or only the transcript as md, txt,
srt or vtt.

options.name: --segments
options.description:
Add a segments array of {start, end, text} to the
JSON, with times in seconds.

options.name: --list-languages
options.description: List the video's caption tracks as JSON and exit.

options.name: --proxy
options.description:
Send requests through this proxy, such as
http://host:8080 or socks5://host:1080. Without it,
HTTPS_PROXY and the system proxy are used.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Give up after this many seconds (default: none).

options.name: --compact
options.description: Write compact JSON instead of indented JSON.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the ytx version and exit.
Output:
JSON (or the chosen format) is written to stdout. Diagnostics are written
to stderr.
Exit codes:
0  Success, including videos with no captions
1  Video retrieval or another runtime error
2  Invalid command-line usage or input
3  Metadata written, but captions were blocked or failed
130  Cancelled with Ctrl+C

arguments.name: URL_OR_VIDEO_ID
arguments.description:
A YouTube URL or video ID. Put '--' before an ID
that starts with '-'. When given, piped input is
not read. Piped JSON uses only its "url" key.
